"Build a mobile game called Build an Egg. Portrait mode, big touch buttons, cute blocky 3D style, works offline, no login needed.

CORE IDEA:
Players can create their own unlimited custom games, then play inside the games they made. Creating is always 100% FREE. No real money, no paywalls, no ads, no gems needed to build biomes, eggs, animals, or guards.

1. MY WORLDS
Show a grid of all the worlds the player made, with a big Create New World button. Unlimited worlds, each world can be named, given a cover image, saved locally, edited anytime, and deleted. Tapping a world has two options: Edit World and Play World.

2. BIOME BUILDER - UNLIMITED BIOMES
In each world, players can make as many biomes as they want.
For each biome, customize: name, ground type, ground color, sky color and time of day, weather, plants, trees, rocks, water, decorations, background music, and which eggs can spawn there.

3. EGG BUILDER - BUILD EGGS FROM BLOCKS
Players can build their own eggs out of blocks. This is not just picking a preset egg.
Use a 3D block builder grid for eggs. Place blocks, delete blocks, paint blocks, rotate view, mirror, undo, clear, and save.
Customize:
Egg shape: round, oval, tall, square, spiky, crystal, long, tiny, giant
Block types: normal shell block, spot block, stripe block, glow block, crack block, crystal block, metal block, rainbow block
Pattern: build spots, stripes, swirls, faces, or any pattern you want block by block
Size: small to giant
Egg stats: hatch time, rarity, luck, coin bonus when it hatches
Include a full color wheel for every block: HSV color wheel, brightness and saturation sliders, hex code input, saved palette colors, and eyedropper.
Add buttons: Randomize Egg, Duplicate Egg, Clear Egg, Preview Egg with a live 3D spin.

4. ANIMAL BUILDER - BUILD ANIMALS FROM BLOCKS
Players can build their own animals out of blocks.
Use a 3D voxel block builder: 16x16x16 grid, place blocks, delete blocks, paint blocks, rotate view, mirror, undo, clear, and save.
Customize: body shape, head, ears, horns, wings, tail, legs, eyes, mouth, pattern, and accessories.
Include the same full color wheel for every block and part.
Each animal gets stats: Speed, Luck, Coin Rate, and Rarity. Faster animals earn more on the treadmill.

5. GUARD BUILDER - BUILD GUARDS FROM BLOCKS
Players can build their own guards out of blocks. This is not just picking a preset guard.
Use the same 3D block builder as animals: 16x16x16 grid, place blocks, delete blocks, paint blocks, rotate view, mirror, undo, clear, and save.
Customize:
Guard body: build head, body, arms, legs, helmet, armor, boots, cape, or robot parts block by block
Guard gear: build your own weapon from blocks like sword, shield, spear, blaster, hammer, or wand, and build your own shield and hat
Block types: body block, armor block, metal block, glow block, cloth block
Guard role: Protector, Patroller, Runner, or Egg Sitter
Guard behavior: choose patrol path, patrol speed, guard area, and what the guard does when an egg thief comes
Guard stats: Health, Speed, Power, and Protection Range
Include the same full color wheel for every block and part.
Add buttons: Randomize Guard, Duplicate Guard, Clear Guard, Preview Guard with a live walk animation.

6. 10,000,000,000,000 LOOKS SYSTEM
Do NOT make only a few preset looks. Use a combination system so there are over 10,000,000,000,000 possible looks for each biome, egg, animal, and guard.
Combine: shapes, sizes, block layouts, ears, tails, wings, horns, patterns, textures, eyes, accessories, armor, weapons, colors from the color wheel, glows, and effects. Show the player a randomize button and a preview that updates live.

7. PLAY MODE - INSIDE YOUR GAME
When you tap Play World, you spawn in your base in that world.
Gameplay loop:
Place eggs you built in incubators in your base
Wait for them to hatch or speed up hatching by playing
Hatched animals walk to the treadmill
Animals running on the treadmill earn in-game coins
Your guards you built walk around the base, patrol, and protect eggs from egg thieves
Collect coins and spend them on upgrades
Unlock new biomes, place new eggs, and grow your base

8. IN-GAME MONEY, SPEED, AND UPGRADES - NO REAL MONEY
In-game coins are ONLY earned by playing. Never ask for real money in Play Mode.
Upgrades to buy with coins:
TREADMILL UPGRADES: Faster treadmill speed, more treadmill slots for more animals, longer run time, auto-collect coins, coin multiplier, and golden treadmill levels up to Level 100.
BASE UPGRADES: Bigger base, more incubators, more egg storage, decorations, lights, fences, guard towers, faster hatching, bigger coin storage, and new biome unlocks.
GUARD UPGRADES: More health, faster patrol speed, stronger protection.
ANIMAL UPGRADES: Train animals to increase their Speed stat so they earn coins faster.

9. CONTROLS AND FEEL
Touch to place blocks, drag to rotate camera, pinch to zoom. Big buttons for mobile players. Fun pop sounds, coin sounds, hatching animation with cracking egg, confetti when a rare animal hatches. Show coins, speed, and treadmill level at the top of the screen at all times in Play Mode.

Make the whole game colorful, cozy, and easy to understand in under 30 seconds. Add a simple tutorial on first play: Build a biome, Build an egg from blocks, Build an animal from blocks, Build a guard from blocks, Play and upgrade your treadmill.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
